what: Generated by tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs from art/vehicles/*/vehicle.json: every roster vehicle, no hard-coded list.

vehicles.name: Cruz Missile
vehicles.summary: The Playtest-1 car: a Holden Cruze-based rally sedan code-built from the owner's reference sheets (R81), rebuilt against its contact sheet in br-bwju.11: painted pillars and roof with black-framed side glass and a black B pillar; the sheet's lightning livery traced into the atlas (side, bonnet, roof, boot and wing bolts); big angular headlamps in dark brows wrapping onto the wings over a black hex-mesh grille with its round badge; the bent nudge bar with four cyan LED blocks, hex fog lamps, pink bumper wedges and a black splitter; the UHF whip with its coil and red tip; two-part tail lamps wrapping onto the quarters, a boot badge, a finned diffuser with a red reverse-light triangle, hex exhaust and pink L corners; 16-sided tyres on five-spoke rims. LOD0 2037 triangles (qualified budget now 3000). Front drive, 1200 kg (R136: the Cruze is front-driven). The physics hulls are frozen at the P1-V02 bake (the Cruz is in the feel bank).

vehicles.name: Hawk Dash
vehicles.summary: R123's Hawk Dash: a bubbly Aussie V8 sedan in the spirit of the Falcon XR8 Sprint. Rebuilt against its contact sheet (br-bwju.11): painted pillars with black-framed side glass in three panes and a black B pillar, the roof painted and carrying the twin stripes; swept headlamps wrapping round the corner; a black hexagonal upper grille; a big lower intake with mesh bars; vertical LED slots in black surrounds; a wide black splitter; the bonnet bulge and two louvred vents; widebody flares; dark 5-spoke rims; angular tail lamps with smoked centres; a body-colour wing on short posts with turned-down tips; a black diffuser with fins and four chrome pipes; big black mirrors on stalks; the twin stripes nose to tail and the side 'C' graphic with its pinstripe. LOD0 2459 triangles (qualified budget 3000). Code-built from a generated reference sheet (R81). Rear drive, 1700 kg: the Lion President's spec twin.

specTwin.sharedSpec: One spec, two bodies (R123): the Hawk Dash and the Lion President name spec 'aussie-v8' in web/shared/src/roster.json, and their profiles' handling (tuning) is identical, held by tools/vehicles/test/spec-twins.test.mjs. Rear drive, 1700 kg, Cruz-like launch, more power per kilo for a higher top speed; the bodies (hull, wheels, damage parts) are each car's own.

vehicles.name: Lion President
vehicles.summary: R123's Lion President: a bubbly Aussie V8 sedan in the spirit of the last V8 Commodore, the SS-V Redline. Rebuilt against its contact sheet (br-bwju.11): a tall sedan cabin with painted pillars, black-framed side glass in three panes and a gloss-black roof with a shark fin; big fanged headlamps wrapping onto the wings over a barred grille; a black lower bumper with slatted intakes and four LED blocks; a splitter with a red lip; raised body-colour bonnet scoops with black mouths; a whip aerial; widebody flares; 5-spoke dark rims with red calipers; a tall wing on swan-neck posts; a full-width tail-lamp bar; a finned diffuser with four chrome pipes; mirrors on stalks and the black-and-gold swoosh. LOD0 2162 triangles (qualified budget now 3000). Code-built from a generated reference sheet (R81). Rear drive, 1700 kg: the Hawk Dash's spec twin.

Rear drive, 1700 kg, Cruz-like launch, more power per kilo for a higher top speed; the bodies (hull, wheels, damage parts) are each car's own.

vehicles.name: Pig Catcher
vehicles.summary: R123's Pig Catcher: a bubbly outback trail bike in the spirit of the DR-Z400E (no Suzuki branding): tall long-travel forks, a beaked front mudguard, wide plastics, a light bar with two spotlights, and a rear rack carrying a coiled rope and a hessian sack. The rider is part of the model, standing on the pegs in a green MX helmet, khaki shirt and jeans. Code-built from a generated reference sheet (R81), on the bike part set (core, front, back, rider, wheel_F, wheel_R). Rebuilt against its contact sheet (br-bwju.11): a lofted tank and radiator shrouds, 20-facet knobbly tyres on spoked rims with a brake disc and sprocket, a crash bar carrying two octagon spotlights and a headlamp, big black hand guards, a silvered silencer, a rack with a rope coil and sack, and a fuller rider with a peaked helmet, goggles, soled boots and gloves. LOD0 2736 triangles (qualified budget now 3000), LOD1 884, LOD2 588.

vehicles.name: Tradie Ute
vehicles.summary: The owner's dual-cab Mitsubishi Triton (MQ) as a roster car (R123), rebuilt against the owner's photos after the 2026-10-11 review (br-bwju.8): the black flat-top canopy on a flat tray, the platform roof rack with a wind deflector and a rolled awning on the left, the chrome "dynamic shield" grille with swept headlights on a tall blunt nose, a solid black bull bar (light bar, fog lamps, winch hook), the snorkel on the driver's A-pillar, a small lift, plain paint. Rear drive, 1900 kg: heavier and torquier than the Cruz, lower top speed. Rebuilt against its own contact sheet (br-bwju.11; it had none before, so Muse Image drew one from the Cruz layout and the br-bwju.8 render): 16-sided tyres on 8-spoke alloy rims in a dark barrel, widebody flares with a black lip, black-framed side glass in three panes with painted A, B and C pillars, a raised bonnet scoop with louvre vents, a chrome shield grille with seven dark slots under swept lamps, a solid bull bar with light bar, fog lamps, plate and winch hook, the tray painted in the seat colour with tall corner lamps and a black step bumper with reversing lamps and a tow ball, mirrors on stalks, and the canopy, rack and snorkel kept. LOD0 2080 triangles (qualified budget now 3000), LOD1 878, LOD2 596. The canopy's black sides, rack and awning keep their colours under every paint.

vehicles.name: Postie Bike
vehicles.summary: R123's Postie Bike, rebuilt against its contact sheet in br-bwju.11: a bent leg shield with bowed facets and a floor wedge with rubber pads; lugged tyres on black four-diameter spoked wheels; an octagon headlamp with rim and lens; swept silver bars with black grips and round mirrors on stalks; twin hex mufflers with header pipes and shocks; a front mudguard with skirts; a silver wire carrier with a postal-red mail tub and parcels; open-top panniers with lid rims and parcels; a rounded rear grab rail, tail block with brake cap and hex lens. The rider is part of the model: faceted white helmet with a grey lower ring and a clear visor frame, hi-vis vest with bands and stripes, puffy blue sleeves, shorts and tall boots. LOD0 2782 triangles (qualified budget now 3000). The physics hulls are frozen at the br-bwju.5 bake.
